---
name: "bills"
description: "Read a Thai electricity or water bill, log it in the monthly tracker, and investigate any spike against the last three months."
---

Run `household-bills` with the `home-manager` agent for: **สิ่งที่ผู้ใช้ระบุมากับคำสั่ง**

Use the units and amounts printed on the bill, not estimates. Check the current Ft and tariff with กฟน./กฟภ./กกพ. before splitting the bill into its parts; anything not checked is marked (รอยืนยัน). If this month is more than 20% above the 3-month average, run the spike checklist.
